size_rationale: Small because it is a one-line fix in the logout endpoint's own service function, which the prompt points at by naming POST /v1/auth/logout and its 404 'Not found'.
prompt: POST /v1/auth/logout returns 404 'Not found' for the refresh token a user got from login a moment earlier, so nobody can log out.

root_cause.detail: logout looks the refresh token up with blacklisted: true, so a valid (non-blacklisted) token is never found and the service throws 404 'Not found'.

fail_to_pass: tests/integration/auth.test.js > Auth routes > POST /v1/auth/logout > should return 204 if refresh token is valid
oracle.cmd: npx jest tests/integration/auth.test.js -t 'should return 204 if refresh token is valid'
